clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in 
me under the Emergency Relief Ap­
propriation Act of 1935 (49 Stat. 115, 
118), and the act entitled “An Act to 
provide that funds allocated to Puerto 
Rico under the Emergency Relief Ap­
propriation Act of 1935 may be expended 
for permanent rehabilitation, and for 
other purposes”»  approved February 11, 
1936 (49 Stat. 1135), I hereby appoint 
William C. Strand, Director, Office of 
Territories, Department of the Interior, 
as Administrator of the Puerto Rico 
Reconstruction A d m in istra tio n , vice 
James P. Davis, resigned, to serve with­
out additional compensation, and to ex­
ercise and discharge the functions, 
duties, and authority conferred upon the 
Puerto Rico Reconstruction Administra­
tion and the Administrator by Executive 
Orders No. 7057 of May 28,1935, No. 7180 
of September 6, 1935, as amended by 
No. 7554 of February 17, 1937, and No. 
7689 of August 12, 1937.
The said Executive orders are hereby 
amended accordingly.
